# UX Requirements Checklist: GUI Navigation and Information

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability
of navigation and Info-view requirements before implementation planning
**Created**: 2026-08-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by `/speckit-checklist` for standard-depth
PR review, focusing on navigation hierarchy and accessible product identity.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all required navigation items and their complete order explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are the identity fields required in Info enumerated without relying on an implied "about page" convention? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are every external destination and its user-facing purpose documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are offline and daemon-unavailable requirements defined for the local information surface? [Coverage, Spec §US2.4, §FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the authoritative Activity terminology distinguished from the historical Logs wording? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 Is "exact version" clarified to include development as well as release identifiers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK007 Is reuse of the existing official mark distinguished from creating or duplicating brand assets? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK008 Are descriptive-link expectations clear enough to prevent ambiguous raw-address labels? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007–FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are navigation-order requirements consistent across the user story, functional requirements, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §FR-001, §SC-001]
- [x] CHK010 Are identity-content requirements consistent with the explicit no-backend and no-network boundary? [Consistency, Spec §US2, §FR-004–FR-008]
- [x] CHK011 Does badge behavior remain consistent with Activity staying ahead of the final Info item? [Consistency, Spec §US1.2, §FR-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Can the complete sidebar order be objectively assessed with one exact sequence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK013 Can required Info content be counted and matched to canonical destinations? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK014 Is the done boundary tied to complete satisfaction of both scoped issues and all repository gates? [Traceability, Spec §SC-005–SC-006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Are normal navigation, dynamic badge updates, and unchanged existing-view behavior all addressed separately? [Coverage, Spec §US1.1–US1.3]
- [x] CHK016 Are development versions, long version strings, image-independent identity, and external-link labeling addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Is responsibility for opening external destinations clearly bounded to the desktop environment? [Boundary, Spec §US2.4, §FR-011]

## Accessibility and Dependencies

- [x] CHK018 Are text alternatives and visible destination labels required so identity is not conveyed by imagery alone? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-009, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Are readable hierarchy, aspect-ratio preservation, and supported-window behavior documented? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK020 Are the existing version source, embedded mark, and standard hyperlink behavior recorded as dependencies or assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- All 20 standard-depth requirements-quality checks pass. The checklist tests
  what the specification says, not whether the implementation already works.
